chunks: My father narrated to me from Aḥmad ibn ʿĪsā, who said: Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad narrated to me, from his father, from his grandfather, peace be upon him.
Regarding His, Mighty and Majestic, saying:
They recognize the favor of Allah, then they deny it.
He said: When this was revealed:
Your guardian is only Allah and His Messenger and those who believe, those who establish the salat and give the zakat while they are bowing.

A group from the companions of the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, gathered in the mosque of al-Madinah. Some of them said to others: What do you say regarding this verse? Some of them said: If we disbelieve in this verse, we would disbelieve in the rest of it; and if we believe, then this would be humiliation when the son of Abī Ṭālib is given authority over us. So they said: We know that Muḥammad is truthful in what he says, but we will be loyal to him and we will not obey ʿAlī in what he commands us.
He said: Then this verse was revealed: They recognize the favor of Allah, then they deny it. They recognize—meaning the wilayah of ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib—and most of them are disbelievers in the wilayah.

key_terms.الزَّكَاةَ: zakat (alms-tax), mentioned in the verse of wilayah
key_terms.الَّذِينَ آمَنُوا: those who believe, interpreted here in connection with Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.الْكَافِرُونَ: those who disbelieve, here in the sense of rejecting the wilayah
key_terms.رَاكِعُونَ: bowing in rukuʿ, describing the state in which zakat was given
key_terms.نِعْمَتَ اللَّهِ: the divine favor, interpreted here as the bestowed wilayah
key_terms.وَلَايَةَ: wilayah, divinely sanctioned authority and guardianship
key_terms.وَلِيُّكُمُ: your guardian or authority-holder in the sense of divinely appointed leadership

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith interpret the verse 'They recognize the favor of Allah, then they deny it' in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith presents a tafsir of the verse about recognizing and then denying the favor of Allah, interpreting that favor as the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام. It connects the verse of wilayah to the reaction of some companions, who acknowledged the truth of the revelation yet refused obedience to ʿAlī عليه السلام. The report highlights wilayah as a decisive divine favor and a test of faith and submission.

en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Al Hashimy who said, ‘My father narrated to me, from Ahmad Bin Isa who said, ‘Ja’far Bin Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> narrated to me, from his<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, from his<sup>asws</sup> grandfather<sup>asws</sup>
regarding the Words of the Mighty and Majestic
[16:83] They are recognising the Favour of Allah, then they are denying it.

[5:55] But rather, only Allah is your Guardian and His Rasool and those who believe, those who are establishing the Prayers and are paying the Zakat while bowing, a number of the companions of Rasool-Allahsaww gathered in the Masjid of Al-Medina. So some of them said to the others, ‘What are you saying regarding this Verse?’ So, some of them said, ‘If we were to disbelieve in this Verse, we would be disbelieving with the rest of it, and if we believe, so this would be a humiliation when the sonasws of Abu Talibas would be empowered upon us’. So they said, ‘We have known that Muhammadsaww is truthful in whatever hesaww is saying, but we shall turn back on himsaww and we will not obey Aliasws in what hesaww is commanding us’.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Thus, this Verse was Revealed
[16:83] They are recognising the Favour of Allah, then they are denying it – Meaning the Wilayah of Aliasws Bin Abu Talibasws, and most of them are disbelievers in the Wilayah’.
en.sarwar: 77. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Ni‘man from Salam who has said the following.
“I asked abu Ja‘far (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.
“(Among) the servants of the Beneficent God are those who walk gently on the earth . .” [25:63]
The Imam (a.s.) said, “They are the executors of the will (The Holy Prophet (s.a) who are afraid of their enemies.”

Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu‘alla ibn Muhammad from Bastam ibn Murra from ishaq ibn Hassa’n from al-Haytham ibn Waqid from Ali ibn al-Husayn al-‘Abdi from Sa‘d al-’Iskaf from Asbagh ibn Nabata that he asked Amir al-Mu’minin (a.s.) about the words of Allah, the Most High.

“. . to give thanks to Me first and then to them, (parents) to Me all things proceed [31:14].The Imam (a.s.) said, “The parents who must be thanked are the ones who provide knowledge, and leave wisdom as their legacy and people are commanded to obey them. Allah then has said, “. . to Me all things proceed.” [31:14] People proceed to Allah and the guide to such goal are the parents. Allah then has directed His words to ibn Hantama and his friend saying in particular and in general, “If they try to force you to consider things equal to Me,. .” [31:15] It speaks of the will of The Holy Prophet (s.a). It demands not to ignore the command to obey him (Ali (a.s.) otherwise, do not obey them (parents) and do not listen to them. Then Allah has directed His words to the parents. “Maintain lawful relations with them in this world. .” [31:15] It says that propagate the virtue and excellence of the (spiritual) parents and call people to their guidance which is also mentioned in these words of Allah. “. . and follow the path of those who turn in repentance to Me. To Me you will all return. .” [31:15] The Imam (a.s.) said, “To Allah then to us. You must be pious before Allah and do not disobey the parents. To please them is to please Allah and to cause them anger is to cause anger to Allah.”
